## Activity

During April 2026, Oakridge Primary Care recorded 98 captures. This activity reflects the imaging completed by the site during the reporting month. The service should continue to monitor capture volumes alongside image quality and grading outcomes to support timely review and appropriate follow-up.

## Image quality

There were 3 ungradable captures, giving an ungradable rate of 3.1. The site should review these cases through routine quality assurance processes and ensure that any recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk. Recording equipment problems consistently will help identify patterns and support remedial action where required.

## Grading

A total of 14 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 1 day. These results should continue to be managed through the established referral and follow-up arrangements. Monitoring the grading lag alongside referable outcomes will help the service assess whether reviews are being completed promptly and whether any operational issues require escalation. Overall, the report provides a basis for ongoing local monitoring of activity, image quality and grading performance at Oakridge Primary Care.
